title: verification
description: Output of 03_VERIFY: the verdict on one evidence, with the result of each check of code. Contract proposal: docs/verification-contract-proposal.md (decisions of Fonseca, 2026-11-07). There is no confidence score: verification_thresholds has no schema yet (U5).

job_id.description: editorial.jobs.id; existence is checked by code

model.description: model name, or not_reported when the stage used no LLM

created_at.description: ISO 8601 in UTC, with the Z suffix

evidence_id.description: id of the evidence this row judges; it must exist in evidence of the same job, with exactly one row per evidence (checked by code)

status.description: verdict on the evidence; VERIFIED if and only if every check passed (checked by code). Downstream stages accept only VERIFIED (CLAUDE.md section 4)

check_id.description: CITATION: validators/citation.js. NUMBERS: validators/numbers.js on the claim and on measures[].raw. Each check_id appears once (checked by code)

reasons.description: empty if and only if passed; without repeats and consistent with check_id (checked by code). medida_fora_do_trecho: a measures[].raw that is not in source_text. No PDF text goes here, only reasons

checks.description: result of each deterministic check; the LLM does not write this
